subject: Re: NovaPulse on-prem commercial breakdown & invoice cadence
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novapulse.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novapulse.com
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NovaPulse on-prem commercial questions and SOW (draft attached)

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — NovaPulse's infra and security teams reviewed your architecture and we have a few outstanding commercial questions before legal and procurement will sign. Attached is our draft SOW (NovaPulse_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf) with some placeholders. High-level asks:

- Can you break down the "platform fee" into (a) software license amortization and (b) observability/console retention addons? We need numbers by month for a 24-month commit scenario.
- Operator license vs site license: we typically prefer operator (per-engineer) licenses; any migration path or pilot operator credits?
- Support tiers: confirm exactly what is included in Enhanced vs Premium (response times, number of incidents, dedicated TAM).
- Invoice cadence: we prefer quarterly invoices with net-45 payment terms. Is that acceptable, or do you require monthly or annual prepay?

Also: NovaPulse is asking if there's a standard discount for a 24-month committed deployment (we're targeting ~120 GPUs in year 1 across two sites). If you can provide a concise pricing worksheet we can route to procurement/legal.

Please include any compliance artifacts we should expect (SOC2 attestation, data residency statement).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement would like a revised SOW + pricing by EOD Friday if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Director, Cloud Integrations
NovaPulse

Attachment: NovaPulse_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaPulse on-prem commercial questions and SOW (draft attached)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping Marissa and Irene for pricing and legal/SRE details. Quick answers up front and we'll attach a short worksheet:

- Platform fee: we can split as requested. For a 24-mo commit we typically amortize the fee monthly; I'll attach an XLSX with both amortized and annual-prepay views.
- Operator vs site: we can offer operator licenses for the pilot (up to 10 engineers) with a path to convert to site licenses at deployment. I'll propose a pilot credit (equivalent to 2 operator licenses) to offset onboarding.
- Support tiers: standard docs in our public appendix, but Enhanced includes 24/7 on-call with P1 1-hour response and monthly health checks; Premium adds a dedicated TAM + quarterly on-site reviews and a 30-minute SLA for P1.
- Invoice cadence: we can do quarterly invoicing with net-45 for committed deals; annual prepay still available with a deeper discount.

I'll attach a first-pass pricing worksheet (NP-pricing-proposal.xlsx) and an internal note for Irene around operator conversion. If you confirm GPU counts and preferred invoice cadence, we can lock numbers and get a DocuSign-ready SOW.

Vivek
VP, Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: NP-pricing-proposal.xlsx (Excel, 22 KB)

Inline notes:
> Elena: "we're targeting ~120 GPUs in year 1 across two sites"

I propose we offer a 12% platform-fee discount for the 24-mo commit plus a pilot credit equal to two operator licenses. If legal wants a different anchor, flag now.

Thanks — Vivek

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaPulse on-prem commercial questions and SOW (draft attached)

Hi Elena — great to connect. I ran the model and attached a CSV that lays out three packaging options and the amortization slices. Short summary below:

Option A — Standard (no dedicated TAM):
- Platform fee amortized monthly: $18k/mo (24-mo), observability addon optional $2.5k/mo
- Operator license (pilot): first 10 engineers free during pilot, convert to site license at month 6 with conversion credit
- Support: business hours, P1 4-hr response

Option B — Enhanced (recommended for multi-site):
- Platform fee amortized monthly: $15.8k/mo (24-mo) after 12% commit discount
- Observability included for first 90 days, then $1.8k/mo
- Support: 24/7 on-call, P1 1-hour, includes monthly health checks; Pilot credit: 2 operator licenses

Option C — Premium (SLA + TAM):
- Platform fee amortized monthly: $13.5k/mo (24-mo) after 18% commit + TAM credit (assumes annual prepay)
- Dedicated TAM, quarterly on-site, 30-min P1 SLA, includes unlimited onboarding assistance for operator licenses

Invoice cadence: we can do quarterly invoices with net-45 on Options A/B. Option C prefers annual prepay to secure the TAM + SLA credits.

Compliance: Irene confirms we will provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and a signed data residency statement; additional evidence (penetration test reports) can be provided under NDA.

Attachments: pricing_model.csv (CSV, 8 KB) — this includes the per-GPU cost assumptions and a sample 24-month amortization schedule.

Next steps: Elena, if you prefer Option B we will: (1) update the SOW with quarterly invoicing language, (2) generate a DocuSign link, (3) route to legal for the standard redline window. Also flag for procurement that HubSpot deal HS-8742 will be updated with the final SKUs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@novapulse.com>

Cc: procurement@novapulse.com, legal@novapulse.com
Date: 2026-08-07T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaPulse on-prem commercial questions and SOW (draft attached)

Marissa / Vivek — thanks for the quick turnaround and the three-option layout. NovaPulse will proceed with Option B (Enhanced) provided two small edits to the SOW:

1) Invoice cadence: we need quarterly invoices but with net-60 instead of net-45 (our procurement policy).
2) Data residency: please add the clause that all inference logs (KV cache metadata) remain in-region and are deleted within 90 days by default unless retention is explicitly extended.

If you can update the SOW and produce a DocuSign link with those two changes we can get legal to do a light redline and sign. We accept the pilot credit as described.

I'll ask procurement to open a purchase order as soon as we have DocuSign.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Director, Cloud Integrations
NovaPulse

CC: procurement@novapulse.com, legal@novapulse.com
